mapper.select: SELECT group_id, moim_account_id, user_id, invite_code, group_name, group_count, created_at, custom_rule, challenge_type, content, future_deposit_ratio_rule, duration_days, min_count, round_cycle_days, base_deposit_amount, group_status, updated_at FROM groups WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
SELECT moim_account_id, user_id, account_number, bank_name, balance, created_at, updated_at, interest_rate, account_name FROM moim_accounts WHERE moim_account_id = #{moimAccountId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT moim_account_transaction_id, moim_account_id, group_user_id, round_id, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_category, amount, balance_after, idempotency_key, description, created_at FROM moim_account_transactions WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT gu.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, g.base_deposit_amount AS required_amount, gu.current_deposit_amount, gu.group_user_status FROM group_users gu JOIN groups g ON g.group_id = gu.group_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gu.user_id WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY gu.created_at ASC
